title: 第5章 你一条野狗凭什么护得了我第6章 黑风山内围的妖王
slug: 玄幻穿成野狗生崽就能变强
lines: 林野正经了几分。
“我的意思是，我可以收留你，带你离开这里。”
白狼竖起的耳朵微微一动。
林野蹲坐下来，尾巴在枯草上慢慢扫了两下。
“但有个条件，我这条命，只交给未来的伴侣。你要跟我走，就得是我的。”
这话放在人类社会里，多少有点不要脸。
但在妖兽的世界，强者庇护弱者，弱者依附强者，天经地义。
白狼低下头，舔了一下前爪上干裂的伤口，半天没出声。
林野也不急。
鹰巢外面夜风呼啸。
白狼抬起头，看了看洞口。
她很清楚自己的处境，后腿的伤没有三五天好不了。
就算好了，凭她现在的状态，也跑不出这片山林。
留在这里是死，出去也是死。
眼前这条来路不明的野狗，是唯一的变数。
“你一条野狗，凭什么护得了我？”
林野歪了歪头，露出犬齿。
“是谁把你从他们手底下抢出来的？”
白狼没说话了。
她确实是被这条狗救的。
这哪是野狗？分明是只藏拙的妖。
可他身上确实没有妖气。
她试探过好几次了，鼻子凑近闻，什么都闻不到，干干净净，跟块石头一样。
沉默持续了很久。
“你若食言，我做鬼也不放过你。”
林野笑了。
“放心，我这狗最讲信用。”
三天后，白狼的伤好了大半。
林野用山里采的草药敷在她腿上，虽然手法粗糙，但效果不错，至少能站起来走几步了。
这三天里，林野白天出去捕猎，带回来的猎物从兔子变成了山羊，又从山羊变成了一头小鹿，分量一次比一次大。
白狼看他的眼神也在变。
这天夜里，月光照进鹰巢。
林野走到白狼身边，低头蹭了蹭她的脖颈。
白狼僵了一下，耳朵往后压平，过了几息，慢慢放松下来，尾巴轻轻扫了一下地面。
两个小时后。
林野趴在洞口喘气，脑子里已经在盘算后代的事了。
content_en:
Lin Ye was a little more serious.
"I mean, I can take you in and take you out of here."
The white wolf's perked ears twitched slightly.
Lin Ye squatted down and swept his tail slowly twice over the withered grass.
"But there is a condition. My life will only be given to my future partner. If you want to follow me, it must be mine."
This is somewhat shameless in human society.
But in the world of monsters and monsters, it is natural that the strong protect the weak and the weak rely on the strong.
The white wolf lowered his head, licked the dry wound on his front paw, and made no sound for a long time.
Lin Ye was not in a hurry.
The night wind howled outside the Eagle's Nest.
The white wolf raised his head and looked at the entrance of the cave.
She was very aware of her situation. The injury on her hind leg would not heal in three to five days.
Even if she recovers, she still won't be able to escape from this forest in her current state.
It is death to stay here, and it is death to go out.
The wild dog of unknown origin in front of me is the only variable.
"How can you, a wild dog, protect me?"
Lin Ye tilted his head, revealing his canine teeth.
"Who snatched you out from under them?"
The white wolf said nothing.
She was indeed saved by this dog.
Where is this wild dog? He is clearly a clumsy demon.
But there is really no demonic aura about him.
She tried it several times, but when she put her nose close to smell it, she couldn't smell anything. It was as clean as a stone.
The silence lasted for a long time.
"Okay."
"If you break your promise, I will never let you go."
Lin Ye smiled.
"Don't worry, I'm the most trustworthy dog."
Three days later, Bai Lang's injuries were mostly healed.
Lin Ye used herbs picked from the mountains to apply on her legs. Although the technique was rough, the effect was good. At least she could stand up and walk a few steps.
In the past three days, Lin Ye went out to hunt during the day, and the prey he brought back changed from a rabbit to a goat, and from a goat to a deer, and the weight became larger each time.
The way Bai Lang looked at him also changed.
That night, the moonlight shone into the eagle's nest.
Lin Ye walked up to Bai Lang, lowered his head and rubbed her neck.
The white wolf stiffened for a moment, and flattened its ears back. After a few breaths, it slowly relaxed, and its tail lightly swept the ground.
Two hours later.
Lin Ye lay at the entrance of the cave panting, already thinking about future generations.
title_en: Chapter 5 How can you, a wild dog, protect me? Chapter 6 The Demon King within Black Wind Mountain
